correctness.rationale: The complete-bipartite commutator matrix has off-diagonal block M, so its rank is twice rank(M). The exact rank-to-character theorem yields the q^(a+b-2i) factor, the rectangular rank formula yields the product, and the degree-squared sum is the group order.
